question: How much of the earlier 198/224 at R=20km reported source-agnostic false assurance is dependent on a retroactively indexed earlier source sharing the 0.01-degree-rounded arrival coordinate, and how much survives stricter nonlocal sources and historical roster controls?

immutable_source.official_transport: reuse scripts.eog_independent_movement_source_gate_v2._version_zip, source original exact first redirect without new hosts
immutable_source.original_tolerance: publisher distance matches haversine rounded original coordinates within ±2km in >=95%/1090
immutable_source.original_benchmark_reuse: Must call parent analyze_events on the same parsed tables and verify 1090/1090 published distance agreement, 115 historic sites, adult 87 and natal 491 after 1975, R20 false assurance adult 10 natal 188 and conservative adult 9 natal 171 before sensitivity scoring.

frozen_sample.event_tables: published dispersal events only (not stayers); adult vs natal event-level groups, not independent birds
frozen_sample.source_catalogue_construction: Only unique rounded departure coordinates of eligible events in relevant source year range; NEVER destination coordinates or year>catalogue_cutoff.
frozen_sample.individual_ID: UID unique table event identifier not physical ring ID
frozen_sample.rounding: WGS84 lat/lon original 0.01°; no smoothing/jittering or invented colony IDs

frozen_metrics.geographic_distance: same parent WGS84 great-circle haversine, Earth radius=6371.0088 km
frozen_metrics.actual_known_marked_source: always original published banding-derived origin d(s_i,t_i), unchanged across all scenarios
frozen_metrics.possible: minimum of known marked source distance and eligible alternative source distances after scenario filter; if empty, known source only
frozen_metrics.default_historical_source_denominator: 115 unique rounded departure positions from either event table year <=1975
frozen_metrics.false_assurance: count events where actual > R but possible <= R (never interpret alternate source as realized history)
frozen_metrics.coordinate_rounding_conservative: count events where actual > R+2 and possible < R-2
frozen_metrics.exactly_coincident_candidate: any historical eligible alternative coordinate equals target published coordinate pair; count among known source >R separately
per_group_reporting: number alternative unique earlier departure positions
false assurance count and conservative count for all R
number of events with actual source >R and exact historical candidate at arrival in baseline
median and mean possible radius in km, count of possible=0 to document rounding zero
number of events whose fixed baseline false-assurance indicator is removed by each more restrictive filter
frozen_metrics.paired_reference: Report all groups adult + natal and combined sum; compare to original 10/188 and conservative 9/171 without post-selection
frozen_metrics.no_p_values_or_CIs: event rows are not independent birds; no inferential p-values or individual-level bootstrap

numeric_gates: All source ZIP file hashes/bytes must be identical to immutable Dryad 466530
Re-run original v1 on the same rows and get exact source-specific 20km, 1090 total and all original 20km false-assurance counts 10 and 188
All historical candidate sites from departure and only allowed <=year, exclude arrival labels from catalog
All 578 post-1975 event rows included in every scenario and type, no event-based exclusions
For fixed cutoff/site-count and increasing candidate target distance floor, possible radii cannot become smaller and false assurance counts cannot become larger
For <=1965 <=1970 <=1975 widening same source table roster, false assurance cannot decrease; earlier site counts nondecreasing
For 2-earlier-observation site filtering, and same-group filtering, the alternative source set must be a subset of both-table baseline
Original exact baseline scenario must reproduce parent output (if not STOP_PARENT_RESULT_DISAGREEMENT)
At R20 no alternative source negative control returns 0 false assurance by definition
Conservative false-assurance is subset of apparent false-assurance at each R in every scenario
Do not compute ecological movement rate, source probabilities, population occupancy, or EOG-WF endpoint.

stop_rules.retain_historical_catalogue: Year of published event is not verified as known in historical database at the year; even stricter <=1965 or earlier does NOT make as-of claim true.
stop_rules.reference_for_negative_cases: A spatially excluded catalog source is not necessarily an infeasible dispersal source. This is sensitivity to candidate construction, NOT a test of ecology.
stop_rules.single_repeated_site: Two event rows at a coordinate are not necessarily two distinct individuals or same-year occupied population.
stop_rules.forced_source: Actual marked origin always permitted, but data do not give trajectory or probability of movement.
stop_rules.no_source_retrofit: No alternative-source restrictions were prespecified before parent v1 source events were read; this is explicitly a postexposure sensitivity, not an independent holdout.
stop_rules.source_data_privacy: Do not commit, log, store or print exact original source/destination coordinates, year+UID pairs, individuals, raw CSV or event-level calculated values.
